gazetteer_names_needed.name: Kapisa (Begram)
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: ancient Kapisa, Kushan summer capital, Bagram in Parwan province, about 69.30 E 35.02 N; only the admin-1 'Kapisa' exists; used as a capital point with coordinates, not as a region

gaps.what: The 161 loss (Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand) and the year of Kujula's conquest of Gandhara and Taxila (51 is Cliopatria's) are still page-silent: the Huvishka page (reign 150-190) describes no loss or retreat, the Indo-Parthian Kingdom page says only 'middle of the 1st century AD'.

The end of the Kashgar client kingdom is dated 127 by inference from the Shule Kingdom page (Shule pays tribute to the Eastern Han from 127; the page does not mention the Kushans); the Kushan relation before 127 and the Kushan limits of the Western Satraps' vassalage are dated by no page (the Chastana page gives none).

The 231 Arachosian cells of the 51 shape and the 91 and 127 expansions are Cliopatria's and not on any page opened; the Fergana gain from great-yuan is Cliopatria's reading (the Kushan Empire page mentions neither Fergana nor Dayuan).

Nahapana's lands (Malwa, southern Gujarat, northern Konkan, Nasik, Poona) are not drawn as Satrap before 127 and no 124 loss to satavahana-dynasty is recorded, because Cliopatria's Satavahana shapes -27 to 126 already hold them; needs a joint fix with satavahana-dynasty.

Years 154, 224, 260, 270, 306 and 347 remain Cliopatria's (confidence 1); the Samudragupta and Yaudheya pages were not re-opened; the Abhira dynasty page (Established 203) dates nothing for the Satraps; the Junagadh list of 150 (Sindh, Maru, Kukura) still conflicts with Kushan Sindh to 270; no ruler strip.
The 35-42 keyframe is drawn in both this dossier and indo-scythians (whose loss is dated 43); the page supports 35.

Whether the western half was independent between 225 and c. 230, and the 259 end (Cliopatria's row change; the Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom page runs c. 230 to c. 365), are page-silent; the identity with indo-sasanian-empire is me-06's.

problems: Repair run of sa-02-c: kushan-empire, western-satraps and western-kushans re-validated with --resolve (0 errors; warnings: kushan-empire 0, western-satraps 3 = unknown slug abhira-dynasty plus the two expected 476/480 stub shapes, western-kushans 1 = a vassal_start with no vassal_end by design). eastern-kushans was not touched (reviewer's fix stands; its Gupta vassal phase / kidarites successor gap remains). Nine pages re-opened, none failed.

Requests to other batches: (1) indo-scythians (sa-02-b): move the loss to western-satraps from 43 to 35 (/ledger/13 and the end of keyframe 20), otherwise 35-42 is drawn twice. (2) satavahana-dynasty (sa-02-b): its keyframes 106 and 110 hold Nahapana's lands (1,200 cells) through 126 although /ledger/4 gains them from western-satraps in 124; subtract them until 124 (then western-satraps adds a gain and a 124 loss) or set that counterpart to nobody; also a 224 loss of 573 cells to western-satraps (or a successor entry) is missing, its /ledger/9 hands the 215 shape to abhira-dynasty. (3) great-yuan (ia-01): its dissolve in 50 should name kushan-empire as counterpart (168 cells now a gain in kushan-empire /ledger). (4) sasanian-empire and indo-sasanian-empire (me-06): carry the mirror vassal_start 230 with counterpart western-kushans and reconcile the two Cliopatria rows of Q1661685. (5) indo-parthians: its 50 and 90 losses to the Kushans pair with kushan-empire's 51 (Gandhara, Taxila: 133 cells) and 91 (Punjab, Sindh: 1,683 cells, equal to its /ledger/3 region) with one year's difference.

Where I did not follow the reviewer: (a) kushan-empire/western-satraps vassal pair ends 150, not c. 130, because the Western Satraps page ties the end to Rudradaman's conquest of the Yaudheyas (reign 130-150, undated); (b) no 124 loss was added to western-satraps (double-drawing with the Satavahana keyframes, see above); (c) the Kashgar client end moved to 127 (Shule Kingdom page) instead of staying at Cliopatria's 184, and Kashgar was left out of the direct corrections rather than added; (d) for the Gandhara/capital finding both options were applied (keyframe 51 adjust with a 51 gain from indo-parthians, and Kapisa as capital for 30-90).
Q25979: unchanged decision left to the orchestrator (three dossiers vs one with kushan-empire); kidarites still uses the slug kushano-sasanian-kingdom, which has no dossier.
